title: Trap Disarm Toolkit
summary: Disarm a trap with Sleight of Hand and keep the kit on success.

fields.Use: Attempt the trap’s Sleight of Hand check. Success disables the trap and preserves the toolkit. Failure consumes the toolkit and triggers the trap.
fields.Acquisition: Found as loot and sold by various traders.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
